<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#f5f6f8" media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0f1115" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
<link rel="icon" href="icon-192.png">
<title>부부 가계부</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#f5f6f8;--card:#fff;--line:#e5e7eb;--text:#111827;--sub:#6b7280;--primary:#111827;--on-primary:#fff;--h:#3b82f6;--w:#f97366;--inc:#16a34a;--warn:#ca8a04;--warn-bg:#fef9c3;--danger:#dc2626;--bar:#e5e7eb;--r:14px}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#0f1115;--card:#171a21;--line:#262b36;--text:#f3f4f6;--sub:#9ca3af;--primary:#f3f4f6;--on-primary:#0f1115;--inc:#22c55e;--warn:#facc15;--warn-bg:#3f3a12;--danger:#f87171;--bar:#262b36}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Pretendard,system-ui,-apple-system,"Noto Sans KR",sans-serif;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;font-size:15px}
body{padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) 0 calc(76px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
button,input,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none;touch-action:manipulation}
input,select{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;min-height:48px;width:100%;outline:none}
input:focus,select:focus{border-color:var(--text)}
.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.hidden{display:none!important}
.hdr{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:var(--bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 16px;min-height:56px}
.hdr h1{font-size:18px;margin:0;font-weight:700}
.hdr .mon{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-weight:700;font-size:17px}
.mon button{width:48px;height:48px;font-size:22px;color:var(--sub)}
.sync{font-size:12px;color:var(--sub)}
main{padding:0 16px}
.tab{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding-bottom:12px}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px}
.card h3{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:14px;color:var(--sub);font-weight:600}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.kpi{padding:14px 10px}
.kpi span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--sub);margin-bottom:6px}
.kpi b{font-size:17px}
.inc{color:var(--inc)!important}
.danger{color:var(--danger)!important}
.mom{font-size:13px;color:var(--sub);text-align:right;margin-top:-4px}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:8px 0;font-size:14px}
.row .nm{width:72px;flex:none;color:var(--sub);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.track{flex:1;height:10px;background:var(--bar);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}
.fill{height:100%;border-radius:6px;background:var(--primary)}
.fill.h{background:var(--h)}.fill.w{background:var(--w)}
.fill.warn{background:var(--warn)}.fill.over{background:var(--danger)}
.row .val{width:96px;text-align:right;flex:none;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.row .pc{width:40px;text-align:right;flex:none;color:var(--sub);font-size:12px}
.split{display:flex;height:14px;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bar);margin-bottom:10px}
.split i{display:block;height:100%}
.legend{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px;color:var(--sub)}
.dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle}
.bars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;height:90px}
.bars i{flex:1;background:var(--primary);opacity:.75;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;min-height:2px}
.bars i:last-child{opacity:1}
.axis{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:var(--sub);margin-top:6px}
.top3 div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px}
.top3 div:last-child{border:0}
.top3 small{color:var(--sub);display:block;font-size:12px}
.empty{text-align:center;color:var(--sub);padding:24px 0;font-size:14px}
.filters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.filters .full{grid-column:1/-1}
.search{width:100%}
.sumline{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px;color:var(--sub);padding:0 4px}
.grp{font-size:13px;color:var(--sub);margin:12px 4px 4px;font-weight:600}
.item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:6px;min-height:56px;text-align:left;width:100%}
.item .main{flex:1;min-width:0}
.item .t1{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.item .t2{font-size:12px;color:var(--sub);margin-top:3px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.item .amt{font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;flex:none}
.tag{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--sub);margin-left:4px}
.own{width:8px;height:36px;border-radius:4px;flex:none}
.own.h{background:var(--h)}.own.w{background:var(--w)}
.seg{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:22px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.chip.on{background:var(--primary);color:var(--on-primary);border-color:var(--primary)}
.chip.own-h.on{background:var(--h);border-color:var(--h);color:#fff}
.chip.own-w.on{background:var(--w);border-color:var(--w);color:#fff}
.chips{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.label{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--sub);margin:12px 0 6px}
.label:first-child{margin-top:0}
.btn{min-height:48px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);font-weight:600;width:100%}
.btn.primary{background:var(--primary);color:var(--on-primary);border-color:var(--primary)}
.btn.danger{color:var(--danger)}
.btn.ghost{border:0;background:none;color:var(--sub)}
.btnrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.edit-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:6px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.edit-row .lbl{width:44px;font-size:13px;color:var(--sub)}
.mini{min-height:36px;min-width:36px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);font-size:13px;padding:0 8px}
.addrow{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
.addrow input{min-height:44px}
.addrow button{min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--primary);color:var(--on-primary);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--sub);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.5}
.nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);background:var(--card);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom);z-index:6}
.nav button{min-height:58px;font-size:12px;color:var(--sub)}
.nav button.on{color:var(--text);font-weight:700}
.fab{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:calc(74px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--primary);color:var(--on-primary);font-size:30px;line-height:1;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.18);z-index:6}
.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;z-index:20}
.sheet{background:var(--bg);width:100%;max-width:560px;max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;border-radius:20px 20px 0 0;padding:14px 16px calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.sheet .grab{width:40px;height:5px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px;margin:0 auto 6px}
.sheet-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:4px}
.sheet-head h2{margin:0;font-size:17px}
.sheet-head button{min-width:48px;min-height:48px;font-size:14px;color:var(--sub)}
.amount{font-size:28px;font-weight:700;text-align:right;border:0;background:none;padding:6px 0;min-height:56px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.amount:focus{border:0}
.check{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:14px}
.check input{width:22px;height:22px;min-height:22px;padding:0}
.setup-card{background:var(--bg);width:100%;max-width:440px;margin:auto;max-height:100vh;overflow:auto;padding:24px 20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.setup-card h2{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:20px}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:calc(150px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));background:var(--primary);color:var(--on-primary);padding:12px 18px;border-radius:12px;font-size:14px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;pointer-events:none;z-index:30;max-width:90%;text-align:center}
#toast.show{opacity:1}
@media (min-width:600px){main{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto}.nav{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="hdr" id="hdr">
<h1 id="hdrTitle">가계부</h1>
<span class="sync" id="syncLabel">로컬 전용</span>
</header>
<main>
<!-- 홈(대시보드) -->
<section id="tab-home" class="tab">
<div class="mon" style="justify-content:center">
<button id="prevM" aria-label="이전 달">‹</button>
<span id="monthLabel" style="min-width:120px;text-align:center"></span>
<button id="nextM" aria-label="다음 달">›</button>
</div>
<div class="kpis" id="kpis"></div>
<div class="mom" id="mom"></div>
<div class="card">
<h3>작성자별 지출</h3>
<div class="split" id="ownSplit"></div>
<div class="legend" id="ownLegend"></div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h3>카테고리별 지출 TOP 5</h3>
<div id="topCats"></div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h3>예산 진행</h3>
<div id="budgetProg"></div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h3>최근 30일 지출</h3>
<div class="bars" id="daily"></div>
<div class="axis"><span id="dailyFrom"></span><span id="dailyTo"></span></div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h3>이번 달 큰 지출 TOP 3</h3>
<div class="top3" id="top3"></div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- 내역 -->
<section id="tab-list" class="tab hidden">
<div class="card" style="padding:12px">
<div class="filters">
<input type="month" id="fMonth" aria-label="월">
<select id="fOwner" aria-label="작성자"></select>
<select id="fType" aria-label="유형"></select>
<select id="fCat" aria-label="카테고리"></select>
<select id="fPay" aria-label="결제수단"></select>
<input type="search" id="fQ" class="full search" placeholder="메모·카테고리 검색">
</div>
</div>
<div class="sumline" id="listSum"></div>
<div id="listBody"></div>
</section>
<!-- 정산 -->
<section id="tab-settle" class="tab hidden">
<div class="card">
<h3>정산 기간 (공동지출 기준)</h3>
<div class="filters">
<input type="date" id="sFrom" aria-label="시작일">
<input type="date" id="sTo" aria-label="종료일">
</div>
</div>
<div class="card" id="settleOut"></div>
</section>
<!-- 설정 -->
<section id="tab-set" class="tab hidden">
<div class="card">
<h3>이름 / 이 기기 사용자</h3>
<label class="label">남편 이름</label>
<input id="nameH" maxlength="10">
<label class="label">아내 이름</label>
<input id="nameW" maxlength="10">
<label class="label">이 기기 사용자 (입력 시 기본 작성자)</label>
<div class="seg" id="meSeg"></div>
<div class="hint">이름을 바꿔도 기존 거래의 작성자 이름은 유지됩니다.</div>
<button class="btn primary" id="saveNames" style="margin-top:12px">저장</button>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h3>카테고리 (순서·추가·삭제)</h3>
<div id="catEd"></div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h3>결제수단</h3>
<div id="payEd"></div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h3>월 예산 — <span id="budM"></span></h3>
<div id="budEd"></div>
<button class="btn primary" id="saveBud" style="margin-top:12px">예산 저장</button>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h3>구글 시트 연결</h3>
<label class="label">Apps Script URL</label>
<input id="sUrl" placeholder="https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec">
<label class="label">공유 키</label>
<input id="sKey" type="password" autocomplete="off">
<div class="btnrow" style="margin-top:12px">
<button class="btn" id="testConn">연결 테스트</button>
<button class="btn primary" id="syncNow">지금 동기화</button>
</div>
<div class="hint" id="syncDetail"></div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h3>데이터</h3>
<div class="btnrow">
<button class="btn" id="expCsv">CSV 내보내기</button>
<button class="btn" id="impCsvBtn">CSV 가져오기</button>
</div>
<input type="file" id="impCsv" accept=".csv,text/csv" class="hidden">
<button class="btn danger" id="resetBtn" style="margin-top:12px">이 기기 데이터 초기화</button>
<div class="hint">초기화해도 구글 시트 데이터는 남아 있으며, 다시 연결하면 복원됩니다.</div>
</div>
</section>
</main>
<nav class="nav" id="nav">
<button data-tab="home" class="on">홈</button>
<button data-tab="list">내역</button>
<button data-tab="settle">정산</button>
<button data-tab="set">설정</button>
</nav>
<button class="fab" id="fab" aria-label="거래 입력">+</button>
<!-- 거래 입력/수정 바텀시트 -->
<div class="overlay hidden" id="sheetBg">
<div class="sheet" id="sheet">
<div class="grab"></div>
<div class="sheet-head">
<button id="sheetCancel">닫기</button>
<h2 id="sheetTitle">거래 입력</h2>
<button id="sheetSave" style="color:var(--text);font-weight:700">저장</button>
</div>
<input id="fAmt" class="amount" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="0" autocomplete="off">
<label class="label">날짜</label>
<input type="date" id="fDate">
<label class="label">유형</label>
<div class="chips" id="fTypeChips"></div>
<label class="label">카테고리</label>
<div class="chips" id="fCatChips"></div>
<label class="label">결제수단</label>
<div class="chips" id="fPayChips"></div>
<label class="label">작성자</label>
<div class="chips" id="fOwnerChips"></div>
<div id="fSharedWrap">
<label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="fShared"> 공동지출 (정산에 포함)</label>
</div>
<label class="label">메모</label>
<input id="fMemo" maxlength="60" placeholder="예: 마트 장보기">
<button class="btn danger hidden" id="fDel" style="margin-top:12px">이 거래 삭제</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- 첫 실행 설정 -->
<div class="overlay hidden" id="setup">
<div class="setup-card">
<h2>처음 설정</h2>
<label class="label">남편 이름</label>
<input id="sNameH" value="남편" maxlength="10">
<label class="label">아내 이름</label>
<input id="sNameW" value="아내" maxlength="10">
<label class="label">이 기기는 누가 쓰나요?</label>
<div class="seg" id="setupMe"></div>
<label class="label">Apps Script URL</label>
<input id="setupUrl" placeholder="https://script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec">
<label class="label">공유 키</label>
<input id="setupKey" type="password" autocomplete="off">
<div class="hint">URL과 키가 없다면 나중에 설정에서 연결할 수 있습니다.</div>
<button class="btn primary" id="setupGo" style="margin-top:14px">연결하고 시작</button>
<button class="btn ghost" id="setupLocal">나중에 연결 (이 기기에만 저장)</button>
</div>
</div>
<div id="toast"></div>
<script>
/* ===================== 상수 / 기본값 ===================== */
const TYPES = ['지출', '수입', '이체'];
const CATS0 = {
지출: ['식비', '생활용품', '주거/관리비', '교통', '통신', '의료', '교육', '문화/여가', '경조사', '쇼핑', '기타'],
수입: ['급여', '부수입', '기타수입'],
이체: ['저축/투자', '카드대금', '기타']
};
const PAY0 = ['신한카드', '현금', '체크카드', '계좌이체'];
/* ===================== 저장소 ===================== */
const load = (k, d) => { try { const v = localStorage.getItem(k); return v ? JSON.parse(v) : d; } catch (e) { return d; } };
const save = (k, v) => localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v));
let cfg = load('lg_cfg', { url: '', key: '', me: 'h', setupDone: false, synced: false, lastPay: '' });
let S = load('lg_settings', null) || { names: { h: '남편', w: '아내' }, categories: CATS0, payments: PAY0 };
let txs = load('lg_tx', []);
let pending = load('lg_pending', []); // 시트에 아직 못 보낸 거래 id 목록
let budgets = load('lg_budgets', []); // [{month, category, amount}] ('전체' = 총예산)
let sDirty = load('lg_sdirty', false);
let bDirty = load('lg_bdirty', false);
let month = null; // 아래 유틸 정의 후 설정됨
let tab = 'home';
let sheetOpen = false, ignorePop = false, editId = null, busy = false, syncState = 'idle', syncErr = '';
let f = {};
function persist() {
save('lg_cfg', cfg); save('lg_settings', S); save('lg_tx', txs);
save('lg_pending', pending); save('lg_budgets', budgets);
save('lg_sdirty', sDirty); save('lg_bdirty', bDirty);
}
/* ===================== 유틸 ===================== */
const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
const num = n => Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('ko-KR');
const won = n => num(n) + '원';
const p2 = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
function nowStr() {
const d = new Date();
return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${p2(d.getDate())} ${p2(d.getHours())}:${p2(d.getMinutes())}:${p2(d.getSeconds())}`;
}
const today = () => nowStr().slice(0, 10);
const thisMonth = () => today().slice(0, 7);
function addMonths(m, n) { const [y, mo] = m.split('-').map(Number); const d = new Date(y, mo - 1 + n, 1); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p2(d.getMonth() + 1)}`; }
function addDays(ds, n) { const [y, mo, d] = ds.split('-').map(Number); const x = new Date(y, mo - 1, d + n); return `${x.getFullYear()}-${p2(x.getMonth() + 1)}-${p2(x.getDate())}`; }
const uid = () => (crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10));
const activeTx = () => txs.filter(t => !t.deleted);
const sumOf = (arr, type) => arr.filter(t => t.type === type).reduce((a, t) => a + t.amount, 0);
const budgetOf = (m, cat) => { const b = budgets.find(x => x.month === m && x.category === cat); return b ? b.amount : 0; };
const names = () => [S.names.h, S.names.w];
const nameOf = role => S.names[role] || S.names.h;
const roleOf = name => (name === S.names.h ? 'h' : name === S.names.w ? 'w' : cfg.me);
function touch(t) { t.updatedAt = nowStr(); if (!pending.includes(t.id)) pending.push(t.id); }
function toast(msg) {
const el = $('#toast'); el.textContent = msg; el.classList.add('show');
clearTimeout(toast._t); toast._t = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), 1800);
}
/* ===================== 구글 시트 API ===================== */
async function api(method, params, body) {
if (method === 'GET') {
const q = new URLSearchParams({ ...params, key: cfg.key }).toString();
const res = await fetch(cfg.url + '?' + q);
const j = await res.json();
if (!j.ok) throw new Error(j.error.message);
return j;
}
// text/plain 으로 보내 CORS 사전 요청을 피함
const res = await fetch(cfg.url, {
method: 'POST',
headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' },
body: JSON.stringify({ ...body, key: cfg.key })
});
const j = await res.json();
if (!j.ok) throw new Error(j.error.message);
return j;
}
function adoptSettings(r) {
S = { names: r.names, categories: r.categories || S.categories, payments: r.payments || S.payments };
}
function mergeRemote(r) {
const map = {};
txs.forEach(t => { map[t.id] = t; });
r.transactions.forEach(rt => {
const lt = map[rt.id];
if (!lt || rt.updatedAt > lt.updatedAt) map[rt.id] = rt; // 수정시각이 최신인 쪽 우선
});
txs = Object.values(map);
}
async function sync() {
if (!cfg.url) { syncState = 'local'; return renderSyncLabel(); }
if (!navigator.onLine) { syncState = 'offline'; return renderSyncLabel(); }
if (busy) return;
busy = true; syncState = 'syncing'; renderSyncLabel();
try {
// 최초 연결: 시트에 설정이 있으면 가져오고, 없으면 이 기기 설정을 올림
if (!cfg.synced) {
const r = await api('GET', { action: 'all' });
if (r.settings.names) { adoptSettings(r.settings); sDirty = false; }
else sDirty = true;
if (!r.budgets.length && budgets.length) bDirty = true;
mergeRemote(r);
cfg.synced = true;
}
if (pending.length) {
const sent = [...pending];
const items = txs.filter(t => sent.includes(t.id));
await api('POST', {}, { action: 'upsertTx', data: items });
pending = pending.filter(id => !sent.includes(id));
}
if (sDirty) { await api('POST', {}, { action: 'saveSettings', data: S }); sDirty = false; }
if (bDirty) { await api('POST', {}, { action: 'saveBudgets', data: budgets }); bDirty = false; }
const r = await api('GET', { action: 'all' });
mergeRemote(r);
if (!sDirty && r.settings.names) adoptSettings(r.settings);
if (!bDirty) budgets = r.budgets;
syncState = 'ok'; syncErr = '';
} catch (e) {
syncState = 'error'; syncErr = e.message;
} finally {
busy = false;
persist();
renderAll();
}
}
function renderSyncLabel() {
let label, detail = '';
const left = pending.length + (sDirty ? 1 : 0) + (bDirty ? 1 : 0);
if (!cfg.url) label = '로컬 전용';
else if (syncState === 'offline' || !navigator.onLine) label = '오프라인';
else if (syncState === 'syncing') label = '동기화 중…';
else if (syncState === 'error') label = '동기화 오류';
else if (left) label = `대기 중 ${left}건`;
else label = '동기화됨';
if (syncState === 'error') detail = '오류: ' + syncErr;
$('#syncLabel').textContent = label;
$('#syncDetail').textContent = detail || (cfg.url ? '시트: 연결됨' : '시트: 연결 안 됨 (이 기기에만 저장)');
}
/* ===================== 렌더: 홈 ===================== */
function renderHome() {
$('#monthLabel').textContent = month.replace('-', '년 ') + '월';
const cur = activeTx().filter(t => t.date.slice(0, 7) === month);
const exp = sumOf(cur, '지출'), inc = sumOf(cur, '수입');
const bud = budgetOf(month, '전체');
const prevExp = sumOf(activeTx().filter(t => t.date.slice(0, 7) === addMonths(month, -1)), '지출');
$('#kpis').innerHTML = `
<div class="card kpi"><span>수입</span><b class="num inc">${num(inc)}</b></div>
<div class="card kpi"><span>지출</span><b class="num">${num(exp)}</b></div>
<div class="card kpi"><span>남은 예산</span><b class="num ${bud && bud - exp < 0 ? 'danger' : ''}">${bud ? num(bud - exp) : '-'}</b></div>`;
const diff = exp - prevExp;
const pct = prevExp ? Math.round(Math.abs(diff) / prevExp * 100) : null;
$('#mom').textContent = `전월 대비 지출 ${diff > 0 ? '▲' : diff < 0 ? '▼' : '–'} ${won(Math.abs(diff))}${pct !== null ? ` (${pct}%)` : ''}`;
// 작성자별
const byOwner = names().map(n => cur.filter(t => t.type === '지출' && t.owner === n).reduce((a, t) => a + t.amount, 0));
const total = byOwner[0] + byOwner[1];
$('#ownSplit').innerHTML = total
? `<i class="h" style="width:${byOwner[0] / total * 100}%;background:var(--h)"></i><i style="width:${byOwner[1] / total * 100}%;background:var(--w)"></i>`
: '';
$('#ownLegend').innerHTML = names().map((n, i) =>
`<span><span class="dot" style="background:${i ? 'var(--w)' : 'var(--h)'}"></span>${esc(n)} ${won(byOwner[i])}${total ? ` (${Math.round(byOwner[i] / total * 100)}%)` : ''}</span>`
).join('<span></span>');
// 카테고리 TOP 5
const catMap = {};
cur.filter(t => t.type === '지출').forEach(t => { catMap[t.category] = (catMap[t.category] || 0) + t.amount; });
const cats = Object.entries(catMap).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 5);
const maxC = cats.length ? cats[0][1] : 1;
$('#topCats').innerHTML = cats.length ? cats.map(([c, v]) => `
<div class="row"><span class="nm">${esc(c)}</span>
<div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:${v / maxC * 100}%"></div></div>
<span class="val">${num(v)}</span><span class="pc">${exp ? Math.round(v / exp * 100) : 0}%</span></div>`).join('')
: '<div class="empty">지출 내역이 없습니다</div>';
// 예산 진행
const bl = budgets.filter(b => b.month === month && b.category !== '전체');
$('#budgetProg').innerHTML = bl.length ? bl.map(b => {
const spent = catMap[b.category] || 0;
const p = b.amount ? spent / b.amount * 100 : 0;
const cls = p > 100 ? 'over' : p >= 80 ? 'warn' : '';
return `<div class="row"><span class="nm">${esc(b.category)}</span>
<div class="track"><div class="fill ${cls}" style="width:${Math.min(p, 100)}%"></div></div>
<span class="val">${num(spent)}/${num(b.amount)}</span><span class="pc">${Math.round(p)}%</span></div>`;
}).join('') : '<div class="empty">설정 탭에서 예산을 입력하세요</div>';
// 최근 30일
const all = activeTx().filter(t => t.type === '지출');
const days = [];
for (let i = 29; i >= 0; i--) {
const d = addDays(today(), -i);
days.push({ d, v: all.filter(t => t.date === d).reduce((a, t) => a + t.amount, 0) });
}
const maxD = Math.max(1, ...days.map(x => x.v));
$('#daily').innerHTML = days.map(x => `<i style="height:${x.v / maxD * 100}%" title="${x.d} ${won(x.v)}"></i>`).join('');
$('#dailyFrom').textContent = days[0].d.slice(5);
$('#dailyTo').textContent = '오늘';
// 큰 지출 TOP 3
const top = cur.filter(t => t.type === '지출').sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount).slice(0, 3);
$('#top3').innerHTML = top.length ? top.map(t => `
<div><span>${esc(t.memo || t.category)}<small>${t.date.slice(5)} · ${esc(t.category)} · ${esc(t.owner)}</small></span><b class="num">${won(t.amount)}</b></div>`).join('')
: '<div class="empty">지출 내역이 없습니다</div>';
}
/* ===================== 렌더: 내역 ===================== */
function initFilters() {
const fill = (sel, first, items) => {
const el = $(sel), v = el.value;
el.innerHTML = `<option value="">${first}</option>` + items.map(i => `<option value="${esc(i)}">${esc(i)}</option>`).join('');
el.value = v;
};
fill('#fOwner', '전체 작성자', names());
fill('#fType', '전체 유형', TYPES);
fill('#fCat', '전체 카테고리', [...new Set(Object.values(S.categories).flat())]);
fill('#fPay', '전체 결제수단', S.payments);
if (!$('#fMonth').value) $('#fMonth').value = month;
}
function renderList() {
initFilters();
const m = $('#fMonth').value, own = $('#fOwner').value, ty = $('#fType').value;
const ca = $('#fCat').value, pa = $('#fPay').value, q = $('#fQ').value.trim();
const list = activeTx().filter(t =>
(!m || t.date.slice(0, 7) === m) &&
(!own || t.owner === own) && (!ty || t.type === ty) &&
(!ca || t.category === ca) && (!pa || t.payment === pa) &&
(!q || (t.memo || '').includes(q) || t.category.includes(q))
).sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date) || b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt));
$('#listSum').innerHTML = `<span>지출 <b class="num">${won(sumOf(list, '지출'))}</b></span><span>수입 <b class="num inc">${won(sumOf(list, '수입'))}</b></span><span>${list.length}건</span>`;
let html = '', last = '';
list.forEach(t => {
if (t.date !== last) { html += `<div class="grp">${t.date.slice(5).replace('-', '/')}</div>`; last = t.date; }
const role = roleOf(t.owner);
const sign = t.type === '수입' ? '+' : t.type === '지출' ? '-' : '';
html += `<button class="item" data-id="${t.id}">
<span class="own ${role}"></span>
<span class="main">
<div class="t1">${esc(t.memo || t.category)}${t.shared ? '<span class="tag">공동</span>' : ''}</div>
<div class="t2">${esc(t.category)} · ${esc(t.payment)} · ${esc(t.owner)}</div>
</span>
<span class="amt ${t.type === '수입' ? 'inc' : ''}">${sign}${num(t.amount)}</span>
</button>`;
});
$('#listBody').innerHTML = html || '<div class="empty">조건에 맞는 거래가 없습니다</div>';
}
/* ===================== 렌더: 정산 ===================== */
function renderSettle() {
if (!$('#sFrom').value) {
const [y, mo] = month.split('-').map(Number);
$('#sFrom').value = `${month}-01`;
$('#sTo').value = `${month}-${p2(new Date(y, mo, 0).getDate())}`;
}
const from = $('#sFrom').value, to = $('#sTo').value;
const list = activeTx().filter(t => t.type === '지출' && t.shared && t.date >= from && t.date <= to);
const [a, b] = names();
const total = list.reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0);
const pa = list.filter(t => t.owner === a).reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0);
const pb = list.filter(t => t.owner === b).reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0);
const diff = pa - Math.round(total / 2);
let msg;
if (!total) msg = '공동지출 내역이 없습니다.';
else if (Math.abs(diff) < 1) msg = '정산할 금액이 없습니다.';
else if (diff > 0) msg = `${b} → ${a}: <b class="num">${won(diff)}</b> 보내면 정산 완료`;
else msg = `${a} → ${b}: <b class="num">${won(-diff)}</b> 보내면 정산 완료`;
$('#settleOut').innerHTML = `
<h3 style="margin:0 0 12px;font-size:14px;color:var(--sub)">공동지출 합계 <span class="num">${won(total)}</span> (${list.length}건)</h3>
<div class="row"><span class="nm">${esc(a)}</span><div class="track"><div class="fill h" style="width:${total ? pa / total * 100 : 0}%"></div></div><span class="val">${num(pa)}</span></div>
<div class="row"><span class="nm">${esc(b)}</span><div class="track"><div class="fill w" style="width:${total ? pb / total * 100 : 0}%"></div></div><span class="val">${num(pb)}</span></div>
<div style="margin-top:16px;padding:14px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg);font-size:15px">${msg}</div>
<div class="hint">각자 절반씩 부담하는 것을 기준으로 계산합니다.</div>`;
}
/* ===================== 렌더: 설정 ===================== */
function renderSet() {
$('#nameH').value = S.names.h;
$('#nameW').value = S.names.w;
$('#meSeg').innerHTML = ['h', 'w'].map(r => `<button class="chip ${cfg.me === r ? 'on' : ''}" data-me="${r}">${esc(S.names[r])}</button>`).join('');
$('#sUrl').value = cfg.url;
$('#sKey').value = cfg.key;
$('#budM').textContent = month.replace('-', '년 ') + '월';
$('#catEd').innerHTML = TYPES.map(type => editorBlock(type, S.categories[type] || [], `cat:${type}`)).join('');
$('#payEd').innerHTML = editorBlock('결제수단', S.payments, 'pay');
const cats = ['전체', ...CATS0['지출']];
$('#budEd').innerHTML = cats.map(c => `
<div class="edit-row"><span class="lbl" style="width:auto;min-width:96px">${c === '전체' ? '<b>총 예산</b>' : esc(c)}</span>
<input inputmode="numeric" data-bud="${esc(c)}" value="${budgetOf(month, c) ? num(budgetOf(month, c)) : ''}" style="flex:1;min-width:120px"></div>`).join('');
renderSyncLabel();
}
function editorBlock(title, items, key) {
const chips = items.map((it, i) => `
<span class="chip" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding-right:4px">
<button class="mini" data-mv="${key}" data-i="${i}" data-d="-1" aria-label="앞으로">◀</button>
<span style="padding:0 4px">${esc(it)}</span>
<button class="mini" data-mv="${key}" data-i="${i}" data-d="1" aria-label="뒤로">▶</button>
<button class="mini" data-rm="${key}" data-i="${i}" aria-label="삭제">✕</button>
</span>`).join('');
return `<div style="margin-bottom:12px">
${key.startsWith('cat') ? `<div class="label" style="margin:0 0 4px">${title}</div>` : ''}
<div class="chips">${chips}</div>
<div class="addrow"><input data-newfor="${key}" placeholder="새 항목 이름" maxlength="12"><button data-add="${key}">추가</button></div>
</div>`;
}
/* ===================== 탭 / 뒤로가기 ===================== */
function showTab(name, fromPop) {
tab = name;
document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(s => s.classList.toggle('hidden', s.id !== 'tab-' + name));
document.querySelectorAll('#nav button').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.tab === name));
$('#fab').classList.toggle('hidden', name === 'set');
$('#hdrTitle').textContent = { home: '가계부', list: '내역', settle: '정산', set: '설정' }[name];
if (!fromPop && name !== 'home' && !(history.state && history.state.l === 'tab')) history.pushState({ l: 'tab' }, '');
renderAll();
window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}
function renderAll() {
renderHome();
if (tab === 'list') renderList();
if (tab === 'settle') renderSettle();
if (tab === 'set') renderSet();
renderSyncLabel();
}
/* ===================== 거래 입력 시트 ===================== */
function openSheet(id) {
editId = id || null;
const t = id ? txs.find(x => x.id === id) : null;
f = t
? { type: t.type, category: t.category, payment: t.payment, owner: roleOf(t.owner) }
: { type: '지출', category: CATS0['지출'][0], payment: cfg.lastPay || S.payments[0], owner: cfg.me };
$('#fDate').value = t ? t.date : today();
$('#fAmt').value = t ? num(t.amount) : '';
$('#fMemo').value = t ? (t.memo || '') : '';
$('#fShared').checked = !!(t && t.shared);
$('#fDel').classList.toggle('hidden', !t);
$('#sheetTitle').textContent = t ? '거래 수정' : '거래 입력';
renderForm();
$('#sheetBg').classList.remove('hidden');
if (!sheetOpen) { history.pushState({ l: 'sheet' }, ''); sheetOpen = true; }
setTimeout(() => $('#fAmt').focus(), 60);
}
function closeSheet(viaUI) {
if (!sheetOpen) return;
sheetOpen = false;
$('#sheetBg').classList.add('hidden');
if (viaUI && history.state && history.state.l === 'sheet') { ignorePop = true; history.back(); }
}
function renderForm() {
$('#fTypeChips').innerHTML = TYPES.map(t => `<button class="chip ${f.type === t ? 'on' : ''}" data-k="type" data-v="${t}">${t}</button>`).join('');
$('#fCatChips').innerHTML = (S.categories[f.type] || []).map(c => `<button class="chip ${f.category === c ? 'on' : ''}" data-k="category" data-v="${esc(c)}">${esc(c)}</button>`).join('');
$('#fPayChips').innerHTML = S.payments.map(p => `<button class="chip ${f.payment === p ? 'on' : ''}" data-k="payment" data-v="${esc(p)}">${esc(p)}</button>`).join('');
$('#fOwnerChips').innerHTML = ['h', 'w'].map(r => `<button class="chip own-${r} ${f.owner === r ? 'on' : ''}" data-k="owner" data-v="${r}">${esc(S.names[r])}</button>`).join('');
$('#fSharedWrap').classList.toggle('hidden', f.type !== '지출');
}
function saveForm() {
const amount = Number(($('#fAmt').value || '').replace(/,/g, ''));
const date = $('#fDate').value;
if (!date) return toast('날짜를 입력해 주세요');
if (!(amount > 0)) return toast('금액은 0보다 큰 숫자로 입력해 주세요');
if (!f.category) return toast('카테고리를 선택해 주세요');
if (!f.payment) return toast('결제수단을 선택해 주세요');
let t = editId ? txs.find(x => x.id === editId) : null;
if (!t) { t = { id: uid(), createdAt: nowStr() }; txs.push(t); }
Object.assign(t, {
date, amount: Math.round(amount), type: f.type, category: f.category, payment: f.payment,
owner: nameOf(f.owner), shared: $('#fShared').checked && f.type === '지출',
memo: $('#fMemo').value.trim(), deleted: false
});
touch(t);
cfg.lastPay = f.payment;
persist();
closeSheet(true);
toast('저장됨');
renderAll();
sync();
}
function deleteForm() {
if (!editId) return;
if (!confirm('이 거래를 삭제할까요? (시트에는 삭제 표시로 남습니다)')) return;
const t = txs.find(x => x.id === editId);
if (t) { t.deleted = true; touch(t); }
persist();
closeSheet(true);
toast('삭제됨');
renderAll();
sync();
}
/* ===================== 설정 액션 ===================== */
function saveNames() {
const h = $('#nameH').value.trim() || '남편', w = $('#nameW').value.trim() || '아내';
S.names = { h, w };
sDirty = true; persist(); renderAll(); sync();
toast('이름 저장됨');
}
function editList(key, mutate) {
if (key.startsWith('cat:')) {
const type = key.slice(4);
S.categories[type] = mutate(S.categories[type] || []);
} else {
S.payments = mutate(S.payments);
}
sDirty = true; persist(); renderAll(); sync();
}
function saveBudgets() {
const rows = [];
document.querySelectorAll('[data-bud]').forEach(inp => {
const amt = Number(inp.value.replace(/,/g, ''));
if (amt > 0) rows.push({ month, category: inp.dataset.bud, amount: Math.round(amt) });
});
budgets = budgets.filter(b => b.month !== month).concat(rows);
bDirty = true; persist(); renderAll(); sync();
toast('예산 저장됨');
}
async function testConn() {
cfg.url = $('#sUrl').value.trim(); cfg.key = $('#sKey').value.trim();
if (!cfg.url || !cfg.key) return toast('URL과 공유 키를 입력해 주세요');
persist();
try { await api('GET', { action: 'ping' }); toast('연결 성공'); }
catch (e) { toast('연결 실패: ' + e.message); }
}
function exportCSV() {
const H = ['id', '날짜', '금액', '유형', '카테고리', '결제수단', '작성자', '공동지출(Y/N)', '메모', '생성시각', '수정시각', '삭제여부'];
const rows = txs.map(t => [t.id, t.date, t.amount, t.type, t.category, t.payment, t.owner, t.shared ? 'Y' : 'N', t.memo || '', t.createdAt, t.updatedAt, t.deleted ? 'Y' : 'N']);
const csv = '﻿' + [H, ...rows].map(r => r.map(v => `"${String(v ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(',')).join('\r\n');
const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' }));
a.download = `가계부_${today()}.csv`;
a.click();
}
function parseCSV(text) {
const rows = []; let row = [], field = '', q = false;
for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
const c = text[i];
if (q) {
if (c === '"') { if (text[i + 1] === '"') { field += '"'; i++; } else q = false; }
else field += c;
} else if (c === '"') q = true;
else if (c === ',') { row.push(field); field = ''; }
else if (c === '\n' || c === '\r') {
if (c === '\r' && text[i + 1] === '\n') i++;
row.push(field); rows.push(row); row = []; field = '';
} else field += c;
}
if (field || row.length) { row.push(field); rows.push(row); }
return rows.filter(r => r.length > 1 || r[0]);
}
async function importCSV(file) {
const text = (await file.text()).replace(/^﻿/, '');
const rows = parseCSV(text);
if (rows.length < 2) return toast('가져올 데이터가 없습니다');
const H = rows[0];
let n = 0;
rows.slice(1).forEach(r => {
const g = k => { const i = H.indexOf(k); return i < 0 ? '' : (r[i] ?? ''); };
const amount = Number(String(g('금액')).replace(/,/g, ''));
if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(g('날짜')) || !(amount > 0)) return;
const id = g('id') || uid();
let t = txs.find(x => x.id === id);
if (!t) { t = { id, createdAt: g('생성시각') || nowStr() }; txs.push(t); }
Object.assign(t, {
date: g('날짜'), amount: Math.round(amount), type: g('유형') || '지출',
category: g('카테고리'), payment: g('결제수단'), owner: g('작성자') || S.names.h,
shared: g('공동지출(Y/N)') === 'Y', memo: g('메모'), deleted: g('삭제여부') === 'Y'
});
touch(t); n++;
});
persist(); renderAll(); sync();
toast(`${n}건 가져옴`);
}
function resetLocal() {
if (!confirm('이 기기의 데이터를 지우고 연결을 끊습니다. 구글 시트 데이터는 남습니다. 계속할까요?')) return;
if (prompt('확인을 위해 "초기화"를 입력하세요') !== '초기화') return toast('취소됨');
['lg_cfg', 'lg_settings', 'lg_tx', 'lg_pending', 'lg_budgets', 'lg_sdirty', 'lg_bdirty'].forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k));
location.reload();
}
/* ===================== 첫 실행 설정 ===================== */
let setupMe = 'h';
function renderSetupMe() {
$('#setupMe').innerHTML = ['h', 'w'].map(r => `<button class="chip ${setupMe === r ? 'on' : ''}" data-setme="${r}">${esc($('#sName' + r.toUpperCase()).value || (r === 'h' ? '남편' : '아내'))}</button>`).join('');
}
async function finishSetup(useSheet) {
S.names = { h: $('#sNameH').value.trim() || '남편', w: $('#sNameW').value.trim() || '아내' };
cfg.me = setupMe; cfg.setupDone = true; sDirty = true;
if (useSheet) {
cfg.url = $('#setupUrl').value.trim(); cfg.key = $('#setupKey').value.trim();
if (!cfg.url || !cfg.key) return toast('URL과 공유 키를 입력해 주세요');
cfg.synced = false;
persist();
try { await api('GET', { action: 'ping' }); }
catch (e) { return toast('연결 실패: ' + e.message); }
}
persist();
$('#setup').classList.add('hidden');
renderAll();
if (useSheet) sync();
}
/* ===================== 이벤트 연결 ===================== */
function bind() {
document.querySelectorAll('#nav button').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => showTab(b.dataset.tab)));
$('#fab').addEventListener('click', () => openSheet());
$('#prevM').addEventListener('click', () => { month = addMonths(month, -1); renderAll(); });
$('#nextM').addEventListener('click', () => { month = addMonths(month, 1); renderAll(); });
// 시트
$('#sheetCancel').addEventListener('click', () => closeSheet(true));
$('#sheetSave').addEventListener('click', saveForm);
$('#fDel').addEventListener('click', deleteForm);
$('#sheetBg').addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target.id === 'sheetBg') closeSheet(true); });
$('#sheet').addEventListener('click', e => {
const b = e.target.closest('[data-k]');
if (!b) return;
const k = b.dataset.k, v = b.dataset.v;
if (k === 'type') { f.type = v; f.category = (S.categories[v] || [])[0] || ''; }
else f[k] = v;
renderForm();
});
$('#fAmt').addEventListener('input', e => {
const d = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
e.target.value = d ? Number(d).toLocaleString('ko-KR') : '';
});
['#fAmt', '#fMemo'].forEach(s => $(s).addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') saveForm(); }));
// 내역
['#fMonth', '#fOwner', '#fType', '#fCat', '#fPay'].forEach(s => $(s).addEventListener('change', renderList));
$('#fQ').addEventListener('input', renderList);
$('#listBody').addEventListener('click', e => { const b = e.target.closest('[data-id]'); if (b) openSheet(b.dataset.id); });
// 정산
$('#sFrom').addEventListener('change', renderSettle);
$('#sTo').addEventListener('change', renderSettle);
// 설정
$('#saveNames').addEventListener('click', saveNames);
$('#meSeg').addEventListener('click', e => {
const b = e.target.closest('[data-me]'); if (!b) return;
cfg.me = b.dataset.me; persist(); renderSet();
});
$('#catEd').addEventListener('click', onEditor);
$('#payEd').addEventListener('click', onEditor);
$('#saveBud').addEventListener('click', saveBudgets);
$('#testConn').addEventListener('click', testConn);
$('#syncNow').addEventListener('click', () => { cfg.url = $('#sUrl').value.trim(); cfg.key = $('#sKey').value.trim(); persist(); sync(); });
$('#expCsv').addEventListener('click', exportCSV);
$('#impCsvBtn').addEventListener('click', () => $('#impCsv').click());
$('#impCsv').addEventListener('change', e => { if (e.target.files[0]) importCSV(e.target.files[0]); e.target.value = ''; });
$('#resetBtn').addEventListener('click', resetLocal);
// 첫 실행
$('#setupMe').addEventListener('click', e => { const b = e.target.closest('[data-setme]'); if (b) { setupMe = b.dataset.setme; renderSetupMe(); } });
['#sNameH', '#sNameW'].forEach(s => $(s).addEventListener('input', renderSetupMe));
$('#setupGo').addEventListener('click', () => finishSetup(true));
$('#setupLocal').addEventListener('click', () => finishSetup(false));
// 온라인 복귀 / 화면 복귀 시 자동 동기화
window.addEventListener('online', sync);
window.addEventListener('offline', () => { syncState = 'offline'; renderSyncLabel(); });
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') sync(); });
// 안드로이드 뒤로가기: 시트 닫기 → 이전 탭(홈) → 앱 종료
window.addEventListener('popstate', () => {
if (ignorePop) { ignorePop = false; return; }
if (sheetOpen) { closeSheet(false); return; }
if (tab !== 'home') showTab('home', true);
});
}
function onEditor(e) {
const key = e.target.closest('[data-mv],[data-rm],[data-add]');
if (!key) return;
const k = key.dataset.mv ? key.dataset.mv : key.dataset.rm ? key.dataset.rm : key.dataset.add;
const list = k.startsWith('cat:') ? S.categories[k.slice(4)] : S.payments;
if (key.dataset.add) {
const inp = document.querySelector(`[data-newfor="${k}"]`);
const v = inp.value.trim();
if (!v) return toast('이름을 입력해 주세요');
if (list.includes(v)) return toast('이미 있는 항목입니다');
editList(k, arr => [...arr, v]);
} else if (key.dataset.rm) {
const i = Number(key.dataset.i);
if (!confirm(`"${list[i]}" 항목을 삭제할까요?`)) return;
editList(k, arr => arr.filter((_, j) => j !== i));
} else if (key.dataset.mv) {
const i = Number(key.dataset.i), d = Number(key.dataset.d), j = i + d;
if (j < 0 || j >= list.length) return;
editList(k, arr => { const c = [...arr]; [c[i], c[j]] = [c[j], c[i]]; return c; });
}
}
/* ===================== 시작 ===================== */
function start() {
month = thisMonth();
bind();
if (!cfg.setupDone) {
setupMe = cfg.me;
$('#sNameH').value = S.names.h; $('#sNameW').value = S.names.w;
renderSetupMe();
$('#setup').classList.remove('hidden');
}
showTab('home', true);
renderAll();
if (cfg.url) sync(); else renderSyncLabel();
setInterval(() => { if (cfg.url && !document.hidden) sync(); }, 5 * 60 * 1000);
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) navigator.serviceWorker.register('service-worker.js').catch(() => {});
}
start();
</script>
</body>
</html>
